cat > /root/certrotate/roles/https_cert_rotate/templates/renew-cert.sh.j2 <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

CERT_DIR="/etc/nginx/certs"
CERT="$CERT_DIR/server.crt"
KEY="$CERT_DIR/server.key"
TMP_CERT="$CERT_DIR/.server.crt.tmp"
TMP_KEY="$CERT_DIR/.server.key.tmp"
RENEW_THRESHOLD_SECONDS={{ https_cert_renew_threshold_seconds }}
VALIDITY_DAYS={{ https_cert_validity_days }}
CN="{{ https_cert_common_name }}"
SAN="{{ https_cert_subject_alt_name }}"
LOG="/var/log/https-cert-renew.log"

log() {
  printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$1" >> "$LOG"
}

if [ -f "$CERT" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_THRESHOLD_SECONDS" -noout -in "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "cert still valid beyond renewal threshold, skipping"
  exit 0
fi

log "renewing certificate"

umask 077
openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 \
  -keyout "$TMP_KEY" -out "$TMP_CERT" \
  -days "$VALIDITY_DAYS" \
  -subj "/CN=$CN" \
  -addext "subjectAltName=$SAN" >>"$LOG" 2>&1

chmod 600 "$TMP_KEY"
chmod 644 "$TMP_CERT"
mv "$TMP_KEY" "$KEY"
mv "$TMP_CERT" "$CERT"

log "new certificate installed: $(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -serial -enddate)"

if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
  systemctl reload nginx
  log "nginx reloaded to pick up new certificate"
fi
EOF
echo done
commands.stdout: done
done

- name: Enable nginx site
  ansible.builtin.file:
    src: /etc/nginx/sites-available/https-8443.conf
    dest: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/https-8443.conf
    state: link
  notify: reload nginx

- name: Ensure nginx is enabled and running
  ansible.builtin.systemd:
    name: nginx
    enabled: true
    state: started

- name: Deploy certificate renewal systemd service
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: cert-renew.service.j2
    dest: /etc/systemd/system/https-cert-renew.service
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: '0644'
  notify: reload systemd

- name: Deploy certificate renewal systemd timer
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: cert-renew.timer.j2
    dest: /etc/systemd/system/https-cert-renew.timer
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: '0644'
  notify: reload systemd

- name: Flush handlers so systemd sees new units before enabling timer
  ansible.builtin.meta: flush_handlers

- name: Enable and start certificate renewal timer
  ansible.builtin.systemd:
    name: https-cert-renew.timer
    enabled: true
    state: started
EOF
